description: budget.warn: the spend crossed the budget's warn line (floor*100/cap >= warnPct, a cap that exists and is positive). The spend keeps going — a warn is not a stop — and this is the moment the person the cap is over sees the line cross in the stream rather than at the hit. The engine's once-per-period dedup (last warned row per budget+dimension) means each warn is emitted exactly once; a day-windowed warn can fire again only after the rolling window has passed. Carries the notify hint (warning tone) — the one delivery-time annotation a toast-worthy budget moment gets.
